classification.difficultyReason: Apply a specified half-turn by reversing both coordinate signs and plotting the images; the repeated points introduce no additional decisions.

content.prompt: Plot the points listed below onto a number plane. Find their images under a rotation of $180^\circ$ anticlockwise about $(0,0)$. Draw each image and write down its coordinates.

answer.worked: After a half-turn about $(0,0)$, the image lies the same distance on the opposite side of the origin: 2 units left and 1 unit up. Thus $A'(-2,1)$.
After a half-turn about $(0,0)$, the image lies 2 units left and 2 units up. Thus $B'(-2,2)$.
After a half-turn about $(0,0)$, the image lies 3 units right and 4 units down. Thus $C'(3,-4)$.
After a half-turn about $(0,0)$, the image lies 4 units right and 4 units up. Thus $D'(4,4)$.

spec.description: All original points and their half-turn images.
